label: Counterfactual guidance and self-application against imitability exemplars (#2145 lane C round 3)
summary: See docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md, section 'Counterfactual guidance and self-application against imitability exemplars'. Follows attempt 421caba9 (round 2), which left the containment-recognition bridge d1fb6414 at parity with A4 (contained, individuating, value-ranked modes of imitability guiding favouring, not apprehended). Owner-approved tests, applied identically to A4 and the personal source. (1) Counterfactual guidance by outweighed reasons (GuidedByOutweighed): placed diagnostic 1587c760 (guidanceTable, tests d1fb6414) shows the good-tracking profile guided, a fixed favouring not guided (Lean-only fixedNotGuided, general for fixed asymmetric profiles), a fit-only nature not facing the outweighed reason; Lean-only guidanceOfTracking and guidanceLabelIndependent show the test is profile-level, so A4 and the personal source (same profile) get the same verdict. Registration of outweighed reasons in the actual state needs articulated stand-ins (Lean-only degreeOnlyRegistersNoRespectBetweenTies: a degree-only stand-in registers no respect between overall-tied candidates); both accounts can have articulated stand-ins (ideas per respect, antecedent will; modes per respect), sharing #1879's articulation price. (2) Self-application (SelfApplies): Lean-only selfApplicationIndividuates; with determinations as candidates the round-2 theorem is the second-order criterion, so self-application relocates the same bridge one level up. Self-love is available to both (q.19 a.3; Plotinus Enn. VI.8.15, navigation only); ranking alternatives to its own favouring is unavailable to both at a necessary source; self-apprehension presupposes the dispute. Rejected: guidance as evidence of mind (profile-level); registration as cognitive (articulated modes pass without apprehension); self-apprehension as discriminator (question-begging); necessity of self-favouring against A4 (shared). A positive by-product: counterfactual guidance is a further compiled mark the D-nature fails.
blocker: Both owner-approved tests yield parity between A4 and the personal source: their non-question-begging forms are profile-level (blind by label independence) or realization-level (shared structure and price), and their discriminating form presupposes apprehension. Next tests: a non-counterpossible analogue of error and correction at a necessary source; whether the unity of articulated modes needs a principle only apprehension supplies (#1879 for both); whether the source's relation to its modes does explanatory work (truth, intelligibility of creatures) that requires them to be for the source (#1892 through its consequences).
